title: Georgia Power: only his house lost a leg of power

tellings.quote: you mean he goes well you lit up our board downtown like the Fourth of July

plain: In 2017, a man named Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear weapons site, says his house in Georgia lost part of its electric power while no other house did. He says a supervisor at the power company Georgia Power told him, "you lit up our board downtown like the Fourth of July." Woods tells Michels this as part of his account of a UFO abduction, and he mentions photos of the transformer and the researcher Robert Hastings.
